js: 'Settings as categories beside the shown one: the split view at a wide window (a bare /settings shows Network, a click and the arrows select a category, the handle resizes the list and keeps its width), a deep link scrolled to and flashed, a change to Max request body (the accent dot, the category counting it, the save toast; a category switch keeps it without asking, leaving Settings asks; Ctrl+S saves, the saved value is read back after a reload, then put back), text that is no number blocking Save until Discard, the search (counts on the categories, every hit in the detail, Esc clears), and the narrow window (one pane at a time, the back button, the search listing the hits as links). It SAVES: run it on a dev copy, never on production. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/settings-split.json --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr> --podman-guard <prefix>'
